Superhuman for developers

Whether you want to build an agent that reaches millions or need to modernize your org's technology, Superhuman has the building blocks to make it happen.

Build your own agents

Build with the Superhuman Agents SDK

Our simple SDK allows you to build agents that can chat, offer proactive help, and interact with a user’s context. Create an agent from scratch or expand your current tech stack.

Get started

Build on Grammarly, Docs, and Mail

Explore APIs, SDKs, and integrations across the Superhuman suite.

APIs

Manage your org’s use of Grammarly and integrate Docs into your existing tools.

Explore Docs API

Explore Grammarly API

SDK

Create new building blocks in Docs. Add new formulas, buttons, and sync tables and integrate SaaS tools or internal apps into your workspaces.

Explore Docs SDK

MCP

Allow your AI to act on your behalf in your Superhuman Mail inbox and your Docs.

Explore Superhuman Mail MCP

Explore Docs MCP

Admin API

Allow admins to manage their Docs workspaces for the entire organization, including provisioning, auditing, and exporting.

Explore Docs Admin API

Audit logs

Monitor activity and compliance, access security information, and see how your organization uses Grammarly with our Audit Logs API for enterprises.

Explore Grammarly Audit Logs API

Compatibility

Make your website or app compatible with Grammarly so you can build AI writing assistance into your offering.

Explore Grammarly Compatibility guide
